packs.name: HVAC Comfort & Emergency
packs.description: Heating and cooling readiness, emergency demand, and post-load follow-up.

rules.name: Extreme Heat
rules.description: High-load AC conditions or an official heat alert.

pre_event: Extreme Heat Is Coming. Is Your AC Ready?
Schedule a preventive check before the system is working at its hardest.
active_event: Local cooling service is available while temperatures remain extreme.
post_event: Did the Heat Push Your AC Too Hard?
Unusual noise, weak airflow, or long cycles can signal damage after sustained load.

rules.name: Sustained Heat
rules.description: Three forecast days at or above 88°F.

pre_event: A Long Stretch of Heat Is Coming
Prepare your cooling system before multiple high-load days arrive.
active_event: Keep Your Home Comfortable Through the Heat
If the system is falling behind, have it checked before a small issue becomes a failure.
post_event: How Did Your AC Handle the Heat?
A post-heat inspection can catch wear before the next hot stretch.

rules.name: Hard Freeze
rules.description: Furnace and pipe risk at 25°F or below.

pre_event: Protect Your Home Before Temperatures Plunge
Confirm the furnace is ready before dangerous cold arrives.
active_event: Get local furnace help while temperatures remain dangerously low.
post_event: Did the Cold Reveal a Heating Problem?
Have cold rooms, short cycling, or unusual noise inspected.

rules.name: High Humidity
rules.description: Indoor comfort and air-quality opportunity during high dew point conditions.

pre_event: Sticky Weather Is on the Way
Your HVAC system should manage moisture as well as temperature.
active_event: High indoor humidity can point to airflow, sizing, or maintenance problems.
post_event: An indoor-air-quality check can identify moisture and ventilation concerns.

packs.name: Home Services Storm Response
packs.description: Storm preparation and post-event demand for roofing, waterproofing, and plumbing.

rules.name: Roofing Severe Storm
rules.description: High wind or an official severe-storm warning with a five-day response window.

pre_event: Prepare Your Roof for Severe Weather
Secure loose items and know who to call if wind or hail causes damage.
active_event: Severe Weather Is Affecting the Area
Stay safe during the storm. Inspections can be scheduled when conditions clear.
post_event: Concerned About Roof or Hail Damage?
Schedule a documented inspection before hidden damage becomes a leak.

rules.name: Waterproofing Heavy Rain
rules.description: Heavy rain preparation with a three-day post-event response window.

pre_event: Is Your Basement Ready for the Rain?
Check drains, pumps, and known moisture areas before the storm arrives.
active_event: Document the source and request help as soon as it is safe.
post_event: Notice Dampness, Odor, or Wall Staining?
A post-storm assessment can find water paths before the next rainfall.

rules.name: Plumbing Hard Freeze
rules.description: Pipe-freeze preparation and a three-day thaw response window.

pre_event: Protect Vulnerable Pipes Before the Freeze
Disconnect hoses, protect exposed plumbing, and know the main shutoff location.
active_event: No Water or a Suspected Frozen Pipe?
Act carefully and request help before applying unsafe heat.
post_event: A Burst Pipe Can Appear as Temperatures Rise
Watch for pressure loss, damp areas, and unexpected water use during the thaw.

pre_event: Perfect RV Shopping Weather This Weekend

active_event: Come Explore the RV Lot Today

post_event: Missed the Weekend? Your Next Trip Still Starts Here
Browse inventory and schedule a quieter personal walkthrough.

packs.name: Marine & Boating Weather

pre_event: This Weekend Belongs on the Water

active_event: Ready to Make More Weekends Like This?
Tour available boats while today’s weather shows what the season can be.

Schedule a walkthrough and find the right fit for your plans.

See today’s menu and plan your next visit.

post_event: There Is Always Something Good on the Menu

packs.name: Ski Fresh Snow
packs.description: Fresh-snow forecast, live-event excitement, and a long powder window.

rules.name: Fresh Snow
rules.description: Three or more inches forecast with a 72-hour post-event powder window.

pre_event: Fresh Snow Is on the Way
Plan the trip before the storm and be ready for first tracks.
active_event: Check operating updates and prepare for changing mountain conditions.
post_event: Fresh Powder Fell — Come Ski It
The storm has passed, but the snow is still here.

packs.name: Legal Ice Response
packs.description: Restrained safety messaging before ice and service information afterward.

rules.name: Ice / Freezing Rain
rules.description: Safety-forward ice messaging with a three-day post-event information window.

pre_event: Use Extra Care as Icy Conditions Approach
Allow more time, avoid untreated surfaces, and follow local safety guidance.
active_event: Avoid unnecessary travel and document unsafe conditions only when it is safe to do so.
post_event: Learn what information may be useful when discussing an incident with an attorney.
